name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission Implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize DP202216 x NK603 x DAS-40278-9 and its sub-combinations DP202216 x NK603, DP202216 x DAS-40278-9, pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of a genetically modified maize, and its two related versions, for food and animal feed. The maize is engineered to survive being sprayed with several weedkillers. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete, that wider effects on nature and health were not examined, and that allowing these imports would increase reliance on weedkillers. This is Parliament's opinion; it does not itself block the authorisation.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the plan.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed importers, consumers and workers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw or go ahead.
